slides.headline: He was born in Bihar, moved to Delhi at 12, then Wales as a teenager. In 2026, he became Britain's first AI minister.
Kanishka Narayan was appointed the UK's first-ever dedicated Minister for Artificial Intelligence on July 20, 2026
slides.body: Under new Prime Minister Andy Burnham, the newly created role spans both the Cabinet Office and the Department for Business, Innovation, Science and Trade - a sign of how central AI policy has become to UK governance.

slides.headline: Born in Muzaffarpur, Bihar, he moved to Delhi at 12, then to Cardiff, Wales as a teenager - later becoming Wales' first MP of colour.
slides.body: Educated at Oxford and Stanford, with a career spanning Silicon Valley, the UK civil service and finance, he was promoted into the AI minister role after first serving as Parliamentary Under-Secretary for AI and Online Safety.

slides.eyebrow: Why it matters for Viksit Bharat 2047
slides.headline: A Viksit Bharat benefits when someone who started in a Bihar town ends up shaping how a G7 nation regulates artificial intelligence.
slides.body: Narayan's path - Muzaffarpur to Delhi to Cardiff to Whitehall - is a reminder that India's talent pipeline now reaches directly into the rooms where the next technology's rules get written.
